claims.text: The U.S. Air Force describes the E-3 Sentry as an airborne warning and control aircraft combining surveillance, detection and tracking with command-and-control battle-management functions.
This research library record does not imply the E-3 participates in any of the site's illustrative scenarios or establish its current fleet status.
